app.description: Native Linux toolkit for Ren'Py games (GPLv3 port of UnRen-forall).
menu.title: unren - Ren'Py Game Toolkit
menu.subtitle: Select an action:
menu.description.detect: Detect a Ren'Py game and print diagnostics.
menu.description.extract: Extract RPA archives from a game.
menu.description.console: Enable Ren'Py's built-in developer console + config.developer.
menu.description.skip: Enable force-skip of seen dialogue (hold-Ctrl skip).
menu.description.skipall: Enable force-skip including unseen dialogue and transitions.
menu.description.rollback: Force-enable rollback (undo/scroll-back), even if the game disabled it.
menu.description.quicksave: Bind F5/F9 to QuickSave/QuickLoad regardless of the game's own keymap.
menu.description.quickmenu: Force the quick-menu overlay to always be visible.
menu.description.cleanup_restore: Restore every backed-up file to its original location.
menu.description.all: Run every relevant non-destructive action sequentially.
cli.dry_run_notice: Dry run: no files were changed.
cli.confirm_delete_required: Pass --yes to confirm this irreversible deletion (or use --dry-run to preview).
cli.no_subcommand: No command given. Run 'unren --help' for usage, or 'unren' with no arguments for the interactive menu.
